items.name: editor
items.title: editor
items.description: Wordgard rich text with scoped styling, application-owned uploads, mapped paste/drop positions and HTML in/out

items.name: media-asset
items.title: media-asset
items.description: portable, validated asset metadata shared by preparation, upload and presentation

items.name: prepare-media
items.title: prepare-media
items.description: Node image preparation and opt-in FFmpeg video preparation; dimensions, transparent previews, posters and content-addressed files, with no storage dependency

items.name: video
items.title: video
items.description: native video player and poster-first hover/focus previews, touch visibility playback, reduced motion and explicit pause

items.name: upload
items.title: upload
items.description: application-owned media uploads with progress, preparation state, cancellation, retries and local previews

items.name: image
items.title: image
items.description: Next.js images with reserved space and a decoded blur reveal; self-hostable optimization, prepared placeholders, reduced motion

items.name: card-gallery
items.title: card-gallery
items.description: overflowing cards with a shared picker, keyboard and touch navigation; optionally driven by a scroll-stage timeline

items.name: preview-picker
items.title: preview-picker
items.description: a single-row selector for preview examples and languages, with optional icons and disabled choices

items.name: tokens
items.title: tokens
items.description: the studio's voice on top of shadcn's neutral theme: three type voices, semantic tones, the alpha ladder, motion. import it once from globals.css

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: theme-toggle
items.description: light, dark and follow-the-system as one radio group; provider-agnostic, so it takes a value and a setter rather than owning the theme

items.name: code
items.title: code
items.description: a code block highlighted on the server by shiki: marked lines, diffs, focus and word marks, both themes in one render, copy built in

items.name: copy
items.title: copy
items.description: copy to the clipboard, confirmed in place and never with a toast; a button, or the hook behind any control you like

items.name: scroll-stage
items.title: scroll-stage
items.description: the pinned stage: a tall track, a sticky stage, --stage-p driven by CSS scroll-driven animation, acts as checkpoints. an act drives a clip by cueing its playhead (@ag/playhead cue, @ag/clip chapterSpan); a beat's progress scrubs one directly (progressWithin)

items.name: reveal
items.title: reveal
items.description: content that arrives as it enters the viewport, once or scroll-tied, with optional stagger

items.name: scrims
items.title: scrims
items.description: viewport fogs at top and bottom, scroll-linked, never transitioned

items.name: liquid-glass
items.title: liquid-glass
items.description: translucent glass with inset reflections and a directional rim; typed shapes and tones, Tailwind overrides, and polymorphic composition

items.name: media-spec
items.title: media-spec
items.description: the media format vocabulary as typed chips wearing the real marks: picture (resolution × dynamic range), sound (codec × object audio × channels), source tier, language and cut; artwork first, a drawn badge only where none exists, an emphasis ladder named for its look, a trailing slot per axis; values in, marks and words owned by the chip, monochrome on any palette until a consumer sets its inks

items.name: avatar
items.title: avatar
items.description: a person's face, the same object everywhere it appears: one round crop on the studio's rungs, positioned on the subject from the portrait's sidecar, ringed in the picture's own colour, and opening the full portrait alone in a lightbox of its own when it is worth a look

items.name: quote
items.title: quote
items.description: somebody else's words, and the social preview of them: the card and the still read one set of rules, so a shared link and the page it opens cannot drift apart

items.name: quote-card
items.title: quote-card
items.description: a quote's rules: the accent it keeps, the size ladder its text is set at, the wrap, and the SVG still. framework-free, so a build script or an og route can draw one without React

items.name: terminal
items.title: terminal
items.description: a phosphor terminal that plays a session script live; the still renderer in terminal-session draws the same frame

items.name: terminal-session
items.title: terminal-session
items.description: the session script the terminal plays: parse, palette, timeline (with its clip, one chapter per command), and the SVG still renderer that draws the same frame. framework-free, so a build script can render a still without React

items.name: agent-session
items.title: agent-session
items.description: a coding agent's session as data: prompts, replies, tool calls with their results, and the working line. the claude-code and codex skins draw it. framework-free

items.name: claude-code
items.title: claude-code
items.description: Claude Code's terminal UI drawn from an agent-session: the welcome box, the transcript with its tool calls and results, the working line, the prompt box

items.name: codex
items.title: codex
items.description: OpenAI Codex CLI's terminal UI drawn from an agent-session: the header, the transcript with the commands it ran, the working line, the composer

items.name: keys
items.title: keys
items.description: keyboard shortcuts as data: any notation (⌃⌥⌘A, ctrl+alt+cmd+a, ← →) split into the keys pressed in the Mac's glyphs, anything that is not keys refused, and shortcuts found inside text. framework-free

items.name: kbd
items.title: kbd
items.description: keyboard shortcuts drawn as keys: one shortcut in any notation, or a sentence with its shortcuts as keys; isKeys tells a shortcut from a command

items.name: clip
items.title: clip
items.description: anything drawn from a moment, as the facts a driver moves through it by: its length and its chapters. the player plays a clip, a scroll stage scrolls it, a fixed progress is a still. framework-free

items.name: person
items.title: person
items.description: a person as every surface that shows one needs them: the name, the @handle, the picture and its animated video. defined once by the page and handed to each component (a chat's contact, a Mac's lock-screen account), so the same person wears the same face everywhere. framework-free

items.name: playhead
items.title: playhead
items.description: where a clip is and where it is going, one clock walking the first to the second in view: Playback plays a clip once with no controls (from a start, after a delay), a cue from a scroll stage aims it act by act, usePlayhead reads the moment in the content. every driver sets the target, so scroll and a player's bar move the same playhead

items.name: player
items.title: player
items.description: a player for anything drawn from a progress: playback's clock with a thick timeline cut into chapters under the content, hover to preview any frame, click or drag or swipe to scrub, keys for play and chapters. takes a scroll stage's cue too, so scroll and the bar drive one playhead

items.name: macos
items.title: macos
items.description: a menu bar app performed on a Mac screen: its glyph, its real menu or its own rendered popover, the terminal driving it, its banners, the keyboard shortcut pressed, the lock screen, the lid closing. draws a timeline the app's own engine compiled at a moment: inside a player it plays, with a fixed progress it is a still

items.name: macos-session
items.title: macos-session
items.description: the timeline a macos stage plays: the step types an app's scene compiler writes, the pacing, and frameAt, a pure fold from a timeline and an instant to the whole stage. framework-free

items.name: web-preview-unfurl
items.title: web-preview-unfurl
items.description: the six facts of a link (url, site, title, description, image, icon) and the one fetch that reads them from a page; framework-free, run once at authoring time and shipped as data

items.name: web-preview
items.title: web-preview
items.description: a link's unfurl as a card, a pure function of its six facts, in three styles: ours (image at its aspect, title at reading size, domain as metadata), telegram's tinted card with the rule, x's large-image card

items.name: tweet
items.title: tweet
items.description: a post on X drawn from its facts, no widget script: author with the verified badge, text with its links, X's one-to-four media grid, video, a quoted post inside, a link card through web-preview, date and counts. the facts are fetched once at authoring time from the endpoint X's own embed reads

items.name: device-frame
items.title: device-frame
items.description: Responsive iPhone, MacBook and Studio Display hardware frames for any app content.

items.name: telegram-chat
items.title: telegram-chat
items.description: a Telegram chat as a pure function of {messages, progress}: peer, bot, group and channel shapes, formatted text with code blocks, photos, the time and views in a bubble's corner, a public channel post fetched once into the same data, people defined once, streaming bodies, pressable reactions with animated emoji, an afterlife that scrubs like the story. a clip on the playhead: play it, put it in a player, cue it from a scroll stage, or fix it as a still. on an iPhone, or frameless at the container's width; focus lifts a message and blurs the rest; crop cuts the phone to a viewport, for a scrolly

items.name: telegram-summary
items.title: telegram-summary
items.description: a link-summary bot's conversation (intro, link, mention, streamed answer) built on telegram-chat, with its clip and where the conversation starts in it

items.name: lightbox
items.title: lightbox
items.description: one interruptible spring over a view: the image leaves the page under its chrome and owns the screen; pinch, drag, swipe, wheel, every key in the table, deep links, a consumer rail

items.name: lightbox-motion
items.title: lightbox-motion
items.description: the lightbox's engine, framework-free: fit, source view, zoom at a point, rubber, pan bounds, momentum, commit rules, the stage band and one interruptible spring; the compositor flight (table, clock, landing); the held-key loop; the pointer state machine as a reducer; the wheel session, with the hand told apart from the device's coast

items.name: lightbox-actions
items.title: lightbox-actions
items.description: the lightbox's action registry: keys, layers, resolve, the escape ladder; one table drives dispatch, buttons, aria-keyshortcuts and the ? sheet. framework-free
